messages.author: b82af643aafe86d2
messages.subject: stan-home confusion
parts:
I still get confused on stan-home.  The cmdstan guide for 2.4 says in section 2.3 that stan-home is "the directory in which
Stan is installed (i.e., the directory containing the file named makefile)".  That last phrase seems to get repeated often.

When I look at what I untarred, I have a makefile in cmdstan/ and another in cmdstan/stan/.  That phrase isn't helping me. :-)

With a bit of searching, I find that section 2.4 says, "The following simple model is available in the source distribution located at
<stan-home> as src/models/basic_estimators/bernoulli.stan,"  and that only works if stan-home is cmdstan/stan.

Would it help to a) remove one of the two makefiles b) figure out a new phrase to identify stan-home or c) put something in the stan-home directory (a house-number?) that says you are now (stan-)home?

Bill

messages.author: b82af643aafe86d2
messages.subject: Re: stan-home confusion
parts:
Having said that section 2.4 clarified that stan-home is cmdstan/stan, make -j4 bin/stan.exe only seems to execute if stan-home is cmdstan:

    me@mymachine /cygdrive/c/Users/wsharri/cmdstan/stan
    $ make -j4 bin/stanc.exe
    make: *** No rule to make target 'bin/stanc.exe'.  Stop.

Bill

PS: At the risk of overloading this posting, the 64-bit Cygwin install instructions close with "At this point the instructions given for installing Rstan finally worked."  It's not clear which instructions are meant: the Windows or the Unix version.

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] stan-home confusion
parts:
Thanks --- we're still working out the kinks due to breaking
CmdStan out of Stan. There didn't used to be two makefiles.

I added to the manual issue for CmdStan 2.4.0++:

https://github.com/stan-dev/cmdstan/issues/22#issuecomment-52659374

The rest is explanation and excuses:

For (a), we need the two makefiles because cmdstan/stan is just
a copy of stan and the cmdstan makefile depends on the stan makefile.
The top-level makefile in cmdstan is what we want to target in
the instructions, so suggestions for (b) would be appreciated.

I'm not sure what you mean by (c). Something like adding a dummy file:

cmdstan/THIS_FILE_IS_IN_CMDSTAN_HOME

Referring to paths is confusing in the same way as "next Tuesday" is confusing
when uttered on a Monday.

The path to the model is wrong. We also just moved our example
models out into yet another separate repo. So we may yet juggle
where it goes some more.

It's very hard to keep doc in synch, which is why I always tell
people I never trust doc, only code! The real crippling factor in
large-scale software development is dependencies --- we now have
dependencies between our doc and our code that aren't automatically
maintainable. We're trying to move to a structure that's more modular
and easier to maintain going forward.

Thanks for bearing with us during this remodeling phase.

- Bob
